text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
With their dance performance over, Maho and
{0} are taking a stroll along the beach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
祝祭の舞を終えた後、{0}とマホは
昼下がりの海岸を散歩していた。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Mmm. The sea breeze feels mighty good.
Taking a stroll after a job well done always feels great.
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー、
潮風が心地ええどすなぁ。
一仕事終えたあとのお散歩はほんま、
気分がよろしおす。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
You feel the same way, right?
A prince and a princess taking a stroll together after a national event...
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はんも
そう思いますやろ？
無事に国事を終えた
姫と王子は
二人きりでお散歩……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: *sigh* It's so romantic. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
ロマンチックやわぁ♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Might as well take a li'l detour along the beach, too,
now that we're here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかくやし、
少し
遠回りをして、
浜辺の方も散歩しまひょ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The sunlight's still a bit strong,
but the water's real shiny and pretty.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
浜辺はちょっと
日差しが強いけど、
水面がキラキラしてて、
えらいきれいどすなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Hm? There's a fair amount of people gathered over there,
ain't there? Let's go see what's happening.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
よう見たら、
なんやあっちの方に
人が集まってはりますな？　
ちょっと行ってみまひょ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Hello!
What are y'all doing here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんにちは～、
何をしてはりますの？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello!
We're actually getting ready to perform the spirit boat procession.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
こんにちは！
今ね、
ここでは
精霊流しの準備をしているのよ。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
It's a special ritual, you see. You write down a wish or
thoughts about your ancestors on some paper,
then send it out to sea on one of these boats.
text_block_list.orig_text:
精霊流しっていうのはね、
ご先祖様への想いとか
願い事を書いた紙を
この小舟に乗せて、
海に流す儀式なのよ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Wow!
That sure is a cute li'l boat.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁ、
えらいかわええ小舟やねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Legends say that the boats reaches the holy beast
following the end of their journey, which channels the
thoughts and wishes on each piece of paper.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
この小舟は
海を旅した後、
聖獣さまの元にたどり着いて
その願いを昇華してくれるという伝承があるの。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Sending thoughts on a journey along with a little boat...
That's such a lovely idea.
Don't you agree, my prince?
text_block_list.orig_text:
願いを小舟に乗せて、
旅をさせる……
素敵な考えやねぇ。
王子はんも
そう思いますやろ？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
How about you give it a try, then?
Here. You can use this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
あなたたちもやってみる？
はい、
この短冊をどうぞ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a million. ♪ Here, this one's yours.
Hehe. It's hard to pick what to write. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
おおきに～♪　
はい、
こっちは王子はんの分どすえ。
ふふ、
どんなお願い事を書くか
迷いますなぁ♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: What are you going to write?
choice_data_list: I wish that Maho's wish comes true.
I wish that everyone will be happy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はんは
何を書くんどすか？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
M-my prince! You'd use your wish on me?
You really don't hafta, though.
Please write somethin' for yourself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
王子はん……！　
うちのためを想ってくれるん？
でも、
そんな気ぃ遣わんで、
王子はんのお願いを
書いておくれやす。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Still thinkin' of everyone else, even at times like this.
That kindness'll definitely make your wish come true. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
せっかくの願い事やのに、
人の幸せばっかりどすなぁ。
王子はんの優しさ、
きっと叶いますよ♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What about me?
I'll be wishing that the two of us can remain
as prince and princess forever and ever, of course.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
うちの願い事？　
それは
もちろん王子はんと、
これからも
素敵な姫と王子の関係で
いられますように、
や。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Here's hopin' that our feelings reach the holy beast.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちらの想い、
聖獣はんのところまで
届いてくれるとええなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Did you finish writing down your wish?
In that case, let's all send the boats out to sea together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お願い事、
書けましたか？
それでは、
みんなで海に
小舟を流しましょう。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Yes'm. ♪
Okay, put the paper on the boat...
And off it goes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁい♪　
ほな、
短冊を小舟に乗せて
っと……
波に乗って、
舟が進んでいくねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Boats containing everyone's wishes,
sailing softly on the waves...
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなのお願い事を
乗せた小舟が、
潮に乗って、
どんぶらこ～
どんぶらこ……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
It's a scene right out of a fairy tale.
Look. Our boat's getting smaller and smaller
as it drifts off into the distance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごく幻想的な光景やわぁ。
ほら、
うちらの舟も
波に揺られて、
もうあんなに小さくなってます。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Make sure you reach the holy beast, now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
無事に聖獣はんの元に、
たどり着いてや～

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's the matter, my prince?
Huh? Something doesn't seem right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん？　
どないしたん？　
王子はん。
え？　
海岸沿いの様子が、
何かおかしい？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
I do hear a rumbling sound getting close and closer,
now that you mention it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たしかに、
ごごご
って
妙な音が
近づいてはる……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: What in the world is going on—
text_block_list.orig_text:
一体、
何が起こって──

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRUOOOGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
M-monsters?!
Watch out, everyone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
魔物！？
魔物が出て来たわ……！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: They couldn't have picked any worse timing, could they?
text_block_list.orig_text:
間がよろしないわぁ。
なんでこんなときに現れてしまうんやろ。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRUOOOGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Oh no. They're heading out to sea...
Everyone's boats are at risk!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あかん、
沖に向かってはる……
このままやと、
みんなの浮かべた舟が……！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: My prince! Let's stop them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はん、
すぐに二人で
止めに行きまひょ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
There's a lot more of them than I expected.
Apologies, my prince, but could you lend me your power again?
text_block_list.orig_text:
思ったより、
数が多いなぁ。
王子はん、
申し訳あらへんのやけど、
また力を貸しておくれやす。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Here I go!
Miracle Mahorin, twinkle twinkle hoy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほな、
いきます～
みらくるまほりん
くるりんぱ～

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
You're next!
Miracle Mahorin, twinkle twinkle hoy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
次はこっちや、
みらくるまほりん
くるりんぱ～

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
That oughtta be all of 'em.
As for everyone's boats... Phew. They seem fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで終わりやろか。
みんなの小舟は……
良かった、
大丈夫そうや。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: How about mine and my prince's—
text_block_list.orig_text: うちと王子はんの舟は……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRUOOOGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
There was another one hiding in the water?!
I'll end it for real this time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
水の中に
もう一体隠れてたん！？
今度こそ、
最後の一回どすえ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Oh no!
I defeated it, but it hit our boat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！　
魔物が倒れて、
うちと王子はんの小舟が……！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Our wishes will sink along with the boat at this rate!
I don't want that to happen!
text_block_list.orig_text:
舟が沈んだら、
二人の想いも沈んでしまいます！
うち、
そんなん絶対嫌や！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: My prince?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 王子はん！？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Are you planning on swimming all the way to the boat?!
But you said you still can't swim that well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
舟のところまで
泳いで行く気やの！？
まだうまく泳げへん言うてたのに……！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: You want my wish to be granted?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちのお願いを
叶えるために……？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Okay. This ain't the time to be standin' by.
I ain't much of a swimmer myself, but...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そや、
ぼさっとしてる場合やないね。
うちも
あんまり泳ぐのは
得意ちゃうけど……！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: My prince! Let me join you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はんっ、
うちも一緒に……
行きますえ……！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
*huff, puff*
We're almost there! Just a li'l bit more!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
はぁ……
あともうちょっとやさかい、
二人で頑張りましょ……！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Yes! We made it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
なんとか間に合いましたな……！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: That monster can still move...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきの魔物……
まだ動けますのん！？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: I need to protect our wishes, no matter what!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちと王子はんの願いだけは
守らんとっ……！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Guh...!
text_block_list.orig_text: くっ……！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
No... Our boat's... sinking...
I couldn't do anything... I couldn't protect... our wishes...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ああ、
小舟が……
沈んではる……
うちも……
うちと
王子はんの願い、
守れんかったなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Oh... He's extending his hand out to me...
It's just a shame that I don't have the energy to reach out...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
王子はんが
こっちに
手を伸ばしてはる……
でも
堪忍なぁ、
うち……
もう、
体が動かへん……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? He's... shining?
It's that power of his... But he's not using it on me?
Then who is he using it on?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん？　
王子はん、
光ってはる……？
王子はんの
不思議な力……
うちにやない？　
じゃあ
誰に……

text_block_list.name: Holy Beast
text_block_list.text: Squeak! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: ピューイ～♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Guh! *cough, cough*
You're... the holy beast!
That's the second time you've saved me now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷはっ、
けほけほっ、
あんさんは……
聖獣はん！
また、
うちの事助けてくれたん？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: But how did you know where I was?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
どうして
ここが……？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that my piece of paper sitting on your forehead?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、
そのおでこに
ついてるのんは、
うちの書いた短冊？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
I see...
You saw my wish and rushed over, didn't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
聖獣はん……
うちのお願い事を見て
駆け付けてくれたんやね。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
My prince! Terribly sorry for making you worry.
I'm fine as can be, though. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はん！　
心配かけて
堪忍なぁ。
うちはこの通り
無事やでぇ♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a million for comin' to my aid too, my prince.
I'd have been sleepin' with the fishies if it weren't for you two.
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はんも、
助けに来てくれて
おおきに。
二人がおらんかったら、
うち、
海の泡に
なってしまうとこやったわぁ。

text_block_list.name: Holy Beast
text_block_list.text: Squeak!
text_block_list.orig_text: ピューイ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
You want to take us back to land?
Hehe. Thanks so much. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
聖獣はん、
このまま陸へ送ってくれはるの？
ふふっ、
おおきになぁ♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Hafta admit, I never thought I'd be makin' friends
with the holy beast like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
聖獣はんと
こんな風に触れ合えるなんて
うち、
感激やわぁ～

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Do tell us if you get tired, okay?
Come, my prince. Let's get going.
text_block_list.orig_text:
疲れたらすぐ言うてね。
ほな、
王子はんも、
行きまひょか～

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
We can walk the rest of the distance now.
Thanks a million, holy beast.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あとは自分で歩けるから、
この辺でええよ。
聖獣はん、
おおきにな。

text_block_list.name: Holy Beast
text_block_list.text: Squeak!
text_block_list.orig_text: ピューイ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
You are just so adorable.
I really oughtta thank you somehow.
text_block_list.orig_text:
かぁいいなぁ。
せや、
なんかお礼をせなあかんね。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
What say we put that practice to good use
and dance together again, my prince?
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はん、
せっかく練習したんやし、
もう一回
うちと踊ってもらえますやろか。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Thanks.
Okay, be a good holy beast and watch us. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうな。
じゃあ
聖獣はん、
よぉ見とってな♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Aaand one, two, three. One, two, three.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それ、
いちにぃさん、
いちにぃさん♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: One big turn, and twinkle twinkle hoy! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
くるくる回って、
くるりんぱ～♪

text_block_list.name: Holy Beast
text_block_list.text: Squeakle squeakle squeak! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
キュイ、
ピューイ♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's copying me.
I'm glad it seems to be a fan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
真似してくれはるね。
気に入ってくれて
うれしおす。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
I really, really can't thank you enough for
protecting me and my prince's desires.
text_block_list.orig_text:
聖獣はん、
うちと王子はんの想いを
必死に守ってくれはって、
ほんまに、
おおきになぁ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Please keep an eye over us...
No. Over everyone, in fact.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからも、
うちらの事を……
ううん、
みんなの事を
見守っていておくれやす。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Maho expressed her gratitude to the holy beast as it made its leave.
text_block_list.orig_text:
聖獣に手を振りながら、
感謝の言葉を告げるマホであった。
